docs: sets a named property of the specified game object or component, or a material constant

Registers a script property, which the Defold editor exposes on every game object and collection that uses the script. Defold accepts the call only at the top level of the script, outside callbacks such as `init` and `update`. A `string` default needs Defold 1.13.2 or later.
